title: Antipasto Squares
description: These antipasto squares, made with layers of roasted red bell pepper, deli meats, and cheeses baked inside a crescent roll crust, are perfect for sharing.
ingredients: 2 (10 ounce) cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
1 (12 ounce) jar roasted red peppers, drained, cut into thin strips

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 C).
Unroll one package of crescent roll dough; arrange in the bottom of a 9x13 inch pan. Layer ham, provolone cheese, Swiss cheese, salami, pepperoni, and red peppers on top of dough.

Beat eggs lightly in a bowl; stir in Parmesan cheese and black pepper. Pour 3/4 of the egg mixture over peppers. Unroll remaining dough and arrange over the top of the peppers; brush with remaining egg mixture. Cover with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake until dough is fluffy and golden brown, another 10 to 20 minutes. Cut into squares; serve warm, or at room temperature.

video.description: A crowd-pleaser for a hungry crowd, this layered dish combines crescent rolls with ham, salami, pepperoni, then adds Provolone and Swiss cheeses with red peppers. Top it all off with Parmesan and eggs, and bake it up until the dough is fluffy, golden and irresistible. Once you’ve cut into squares, this Antipasto with disappear quickly. Great as a fun appetizer, late night snack, or a delicious lunch paired with a salad.
